column3: MT 81:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. The Hebrew title has “Of Asaph”; NASB adds “A Psalm” and sets the title in braces. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “music” is rendered “a song,” and the two instruments as “lyre” and “harp.”
Close to the Hebrew; “ram's horn” is rendered “trumpet.”
Close to the Hebrew; “when he went out over the land” is rendered “When he went throughout the land.” NASB begins God's words at verse 6.
Close to the Hebrew; “did not yield to Me” is rendered “did not obey Me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “If My people” is rendered “Oh that My people.”
Close to the Hebrew; “like a little” is rendered “quickly.”
“Cringe to Him” is rendered “would pretend obedience to Him,” and NASB supplies “of punishment” after “their time.”
The Hebrew has “And He fed him”; NASB renders “But I would feed you.”
